record.question: 'Make in India' is one of the core objectives and pillars of:
record.explanation: Answer B: Facilitate Investment and Innovation. This option best states the investment and innovation pillar/objective of Make in India. Reference: https://www.makeinindia.com/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
